d: Short, messy, rose-pink hair with blunt bangs and two dark grey ribbons tied at the sides. Large, round, bright blue eyes with a neutral expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A petite build wearing a forest green long-sleeved sailor-style top with a white-trimmed collar and a matching dark green pleated mini-skirt. Attached to the lower body is a grey and red metallic naval armament rig featuring various gun turrets and a large cylindrical smokestack.
